studies.title: Satellite positioning (GPS)
studies.caption: A constellation of satellites lets a receiver fix its position anywhere to within metres; it is fully operational from 1995.
studies.prompt: Close field scene about1995 of a surveyor holding a bulky early handheld GPS receiver with a small monochrome display and protruding antenna beside a paper field map; open hillside and distant coast. A small separate study of a GPS satellite with twin solar wings, no smartphone or modern touchscreen.
